newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends slightly lower on technicals.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends slightly lower on technicals.

text.p: CSCE world sugar ended lower on chart-based trading with funds bidding the market higher but failing to break resistance at the intra-day high.
The fundamentals appeared to take a back seat to the technicals, as long funds gave up on the market and triggered stops at 11.57 cents in the October contract, dealers said.

"We're looking at a an overbought market," said Jim Cordier, a trader with Allendale Commodities. "We ran into some upside resistance at 11.76 cents. We were due for a bit of a correction." The active October contract finished at 11.xx cents a lb, down 0.0x cents from Thursday.

"We rallied on 1,500 lots of fund buying early," said one New York trader, "but we couldn't get any follow-through. "The longs got disgruntled and took the market lower. Some locals also got into the act.
"We saw a 700-lot sell-stop hit at 11.57," he added.
Traders noted some bargain-hunting at the bottom of the range. "We consider this a good buying opportunity," said one physical dealer.

"We're due for a bit of consolidation over the next week or so before we begin the next leg up," said Allendale's Cordier. "I would expect us to remain in a 0.20-range until we get some fundamental news to take this market higher."
